'''Food Inspectors''' were utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. An Imperial Food Inspector in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]] unwittingly revealed that the Empire had larger plans for the system after casually mentioning the information to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]].
